purpose: These are previous observations, selected for the lessons after the observation period. They are not an execution tape or a total-return dataset.
corporate_action_status:
These prices have no adjustment. The calendar for each corporate action does not show that all its data are correct. Price gaps without other data do not show a technical break or an economic loss.

Do not calculate investor total returns from these closes.
use_conditions: Use these data only for your lessons with this computer. Access for the public gives no redistribution or commercial-use license. A check of the data providers' rights is not completed independently. Before you give the public access to this data bundle, get a different check of rights.
